name: Eulerian
description: Integrates Eulerian analytics/tracking, including Commerce e-commerce tracking.
project_description:
Adds the Eulerian tracking system to your website.

 The module allows you to add the following statistics features to your site:

 
 Single domain tracking 
 Selectively track/exclude certain pages 
 Custom variables support with tokens 
 Site Search 
 Modal dialog tracking ( Colorbox ) 
 Access denied (403) and Page not found (404) tracking 
 User ID tracking across devices 
 Asynchronous tracking 
 A data cleaning system (using Eulerian's recommendations) 
 Eulerian Tag Manager 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 PHP >=7.3 
 An Eulerian website domain 
 
 For more information about the features of the Eulerian module, you can refer to the module's README .
